text:
alex: Heads-up — after today's Triton upgrade + driver 12.10.2 patch, canary for model-service shows repeating smallbatch latency spikes and batching stalls on a100-smallnodes.
ci-bot: perf-ci/eng-runtime failed: smallbatch latency regression ~18% (see job 9876). https://ci.internal/builds/9876 :eyes:
marta: Ugh. Do we have any nvprof/CUPTI traces or a flame yet? Where should we start the bisect?
devon: Quick repro attached, I can reproduce locally with a minimal script. Repro command: ```python repro.py --batch 2 --seq 64 --model tiny```
alex: Quick dump from a coupler run: ```agg_latency: sawtooth pattern, timeline shows prefetch wait spikes every ~120ms, kernel selection bouncing between matmul_v1 and matmul_v1_fallback```
marta: I also see more L2 evictions in the kernel traces; KV cache miss rate jumped in the canary traces. Could be prefetch+evict interaction.
devon: Confirmed: kvcache eviction delta +12% in the trace. Prefetch thread seems to get starved whenever the selector flips kernels -> backlog -> batching affinity stall.
sre-oncall: This is a canary rollout blocker. Reverting canary now. @eng-releases FYI.
triton-bot: Deploy note: revert started for canary group 'model-service-canary' at 2654321120 by @sre-oncall
alex: Bisect plan: (1) triton 2.6.9 + old driver, (2) triton 2.6.8 + new driver, (3) triton 2.6.9 + new driver. Need someone to run combo #2 on staging GPUs.
marta: I'll run the driver+triton combo on staging nodes and post nvprof slices + timing histograms (ETA 30m).
devon: Try this quick experiment: force kernel sticky affinity in runtime (ENV RANDOM_KERNEL_PLACEMENT=0) and rerun. If sawtooth disappears, selector oscillation is the culprit.
marta: Staging numbers: old-driver+2.6.9 median 18ms, new-driver+2.6.9 median 22ms with 40ms peak sawtooth. With ENV override -> 19ms steady. Traces uploaded to /mnt/traces/2654321000.tar.gz
alex: Nice reproduction, thanks. Next step: bisect autotune/table commits and add selector hysteresis guard in runtime. I'll open a PR for a temporary guard to prevent flips for 200ms after kernel change.
sre-oncall: Revert completed on canary at 2654321280, metrics returned to baseline. Marking this rollout as mitigated — continue bisecting and follow-up changelog.
